name: pdk-ghostfolio-portfolio-snapshot-coherence
instr:
We need portfolio performance to stay coherent across API instances: once a trade is acknowledged, every instance's performance chart reflects it. Today invalidation depends on a five-second timer in the writer, and a snapshot computation can finish after a later write, so another instance can keep returning the old chart.

An acknowledged `POST /api/v1/activities` write is reflected by a subsequent `GET /api/v2/portfolio/performance` on a different API instance, even if the writer is killed immediately after responding. Concurrent `PUT` and `DELETE` activity requests from different instances leave performance matching the final activity state. Updating a balance through `POST /api/v1/account-balance` also refreshes performance, including net worth, across instances. If a snapshot computation overlaps a later trade and finishes after it, subsequent performance reads show the newer portfolio, not its previous value. An older cached snapshot cannot replace the result after another trade. Twenty concurrent reads of an unchanged portfolio share at most one snapshot computation and agree, and later reads reuse that cached snapshot until the next write, even after new market prices are gathered. Keep bearer-token anonymous authentication at `POST /api/v1/auth/anonymous` and activity listing at `GET /api/v1/activities` working.

The repository is in `/app`. PostgreSQL and Redis are installed locally; start them with `sudo service postgresql start` and `sudo service redis-server star
